+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M21ABCXCQMMYMRK3QBM7CCJV

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: b180
+title: 'ItemViewOverrides and the three keyed registries: structured item, content block, attachment (plan §3.6, §7)'
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Thread/ItemViewOverrides.swift` and `Sources/AgentViewKit/Thread/Registries.swift`, per plan.md §3.6 and §7.
+
+- `ItemViewOverrides`: one environment key per `ThreadItem` kind holding an optional `(Record) -> AnyView`. Typed modifiers `.systemPromptView`, `.userMessageView`, `.assistantMessageView`, `.reasoningView`, `.toolCallView`, `.structuredItemView`, `.compactionView`, `.errorView`, `.unknownItemView`.
+- `StructuredItemRegistry`: `.structuredItem(_ schemaName: String) { … }` writes into an environment dictionary; last writer wins. `resolve(schemaName:)` returns the innermost registration or nil.
+- `ContentBlockRegistry`: `.contentBlockView(for: ContentBlockKind) { … }`.
+- `AttachmentRegistry`: `.attachmentView(for: UTType) { … }`. `resolve(type:)` walks `UTType.supertypes` by conformance to the nearest registration, then returns nil so the caller uses the generic chip.
+- No views in this task. Only the environment plumbing and the resolution functions.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] An inner `.structuredItem("x")` wins over an outer one for the same name.
+- [ ] `AttachmentRegistry.resolve(.swiftSource)` finds a `.sourceCode` registration; `.data` with no registration returns nil.
+- [ ] Each typed modifier sets exactly its own key.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Thread/RegistryResolutionTests.swift`: last-writer-wins, the UTType conformance walk, and one test per typed modifier through a hosted environment reader.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

--- original
+++ modified
@@ -1,4 +1,19 @@
 ---
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m2nhzetxdvac736zzgt9khny
+  text: |-
+    ### implement — changed
+    Design decisions:
+    - The environment keys are `systemPromptViewOverride` ... `unknownItemViewOverride` (type `ItemViewRenderer<Record>?`). The modifiers keep the plan names (`.toolCallView` and the others). The key names have the suffix `Override` so that they are not the same as the modifier names.
+    - `ContentBlockKind` in the task text is the existing `ContentBlock.Kind`.
+    - The three registries are one generic `KeyedViewRegistry<Key, Value>` with three type aliases: `StructuredItemRegistry`, `ContentBlockRegistry`, `AttachmentRegistry`.
+    - The structured renderer gets `StructuredItemContent` (schemaName and payload). It has `init(record:)` and `init?(block:)`, so that one registration shows a thread item and a content block (plan §3.6).
+    - There is no `Attachment` model type yet. Task ^sqfhexd adds it, and ^sqfhexd depends on this task. Thus the attachment renderer gets the file `URL` (the value of `ContentBlock.Content.attachment`). ^sqfhexd can change the value type.
+    - `AttachmentRegistry.resolve(type:)` uses the exact type first. Then it uses the registered supertype with the most supertypes (the nearest). A tie goes to the lower identifier.
+    - evidence: swift test, 544 tests passed (521 in AgentViewKitTests, 17 new).
+    - next: commit, then review HEAD~1..HEAD.
+  timestamp: 2026-09-16T16:49:38.653841+00:00
